analyst_view.overall: Bottom side Venezia (20th, 6 points from 12, the only team yet to draw, lost all six away games) host in-form Bologna (9th, 18 points, unbeaten in five and winners of their last four away league games) at the Penzo on Friday evening; the numbers make Bologna clear favourites. Davide Nicola's Venezia lost 4-0 at Juventus last weekend, have scored 3 in six and are without Sverko, Correia and Adorante (in the numbers) plus Franjic, Mazzocchi and Basic, whom three previews list as unlikely to feature but the numbers do not count. Raffaele Palladino's Bologna miss Holm, El Azzouzi, Miranda and Enem (Heggem too in two previews), all of whom were out during their winning run, so their form already reflects it. Neither side plays in Europe this week; the referee is Andrea Colombo (4.2 cards a game), whose record the numbers already count.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, 1.6 of them for Bologna, with Venezia's 3 goals in six already counted. Three previews now list Franjic, Mazzocchi and Basic as out as well, and the numbers no longer take anything off for them, so Venezia's thin attack (Adams and Lauberbach, with Adorante still out) gets a little thinner; I trim 3% to about 2.4. Bologna's absentees were missing during their 12-goals-in-six run, so nothing changes on their side.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, 4.8 for Bologna, already raised for Bologna's 39 corners in six and Venezia's 40 conceded. Bologna lose left-sided width without Miranda but Zortea and Orsolini still drive their wide play down the right, and Venezia keep wing-backs Hainaut and Haps in a 3-5-2 that leans on long balls, so nothing new points either way; I stay at about 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards: they were lowered because Venezia have been booked only 5 times in six games, and raised by about 17% because referee Andrea Colombo shows 4.2 cards a game. A home side rooted to the bottom could get edgy, but this is no derby and there are no suspensions or new tensions in the previews, so I stay at about 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.2 shots, 14.2 for Bologna, already lifted for Bologna's 91 shots in six. Venezia under Nicola still get shots off (75 in six) even when losing, and both teams' predicted line-ups match recent weeks, so the extra Venezia absentees matter more for finishing than volume; I stay at about 25.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, 4.8 for Bologna, already raised for Bologna's 33 on target in six and lowered for Venezia's low accuracy. Adorante is still out, so Venezia again rely on Adams and Lauberbach as in recent games, and Bologna's Odgaard-led attack is settled; I stay at about 8.3.
